newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Seven soldiers die in Philippine fighting.
newsitem.headline: Seven soldiers die in Philippine fighting.

text.p: Moslem guerrillas shot dead seven Philippine soldiers and wounded 10 others in a fresh outbreak of fighting on nearby Basilan island in the country's south, the army said.

The rebels, members of the hardline Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), were believed to have suffered several casualties in the 30-minute clash on Monday in Tipo-tipo town, army Major Fredesvindo Covarubbias told reporters late on Tuesday.

This brought to 13 the number of soldiers killed in sporadic gunbattles on Basilan during the past two weeks. Six soldiers were killed in clashes with the MILF in Basilan last week, according to army reports.

The army spokesman has estimated MILF casualties at more than 40 dead since the clashes began in the last week of October but said this was based on intercepted radio exchanges among the rebels and not on actual body counts.
The MILF is a breakaway faction of the mainstream Moro National Liberation Front that last month signed a peace deal with the government, ending their 24-year revolt for Moslem self-rule.
The government said it had started exploratory talks with the MILF, which is demanding an Islamic state, on a possible separate peace deal with Manila.
